business_problem: replace an expensive data lake environment with a more scalable healthcare data platform that could store more data, improve pipeline reliability, and reduce total cost.
solution_summary: AMN Healthcare uses Snowflake on Snowflake to replace an expensive data lake environment with a more scalable healthcare data platform that could store more data, improve pipeline reliability, and reduce total cost. Healthcare operational and analytical datasets are centralized in Snowflake so AMN can store more information without paying legacy lake costs. The migration replaces the previous data lake with Snowflake’s multi-cluster shared architecture, improving concurrency and pipeline reliability while lowering spend. Data teams and business users work from the more reliable platform for downstream analytics and operational reporting, without the instability and cost of the prior environment. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces copying, simplifies administration, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data for analytics, reporting, and AI.
